parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL IDs, names, max phase, type, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL1122023. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, filter compound_records by doc_id matching the document, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
